avis.texte: Lovely serum and i use morning and night on my aging skin. Because of the naturalness of the line, the smell is meh, but goes away quickly as you rub in.

I love Tulip Dew Drops! I am on my 4th bottle since October ! I love this Serum the Niacinamide and squalene have shown a dramatic difference in my skin texture it's crazy with my aging skin! I will be definitely repurchase again and again.

This product feels nice on the face and it definitely hydrates my dry sensitive skin.

A lovely hyaluronic acid serum that plumps skin and plays nicely with other products. I also use the vitamin C oil, the sunscreen, and nectar in varying degrees, depending upon need. I have skin sensitivities, and this range does not cause any breakouts, stinging or redness. Recommend, recommend, recommend!
This is a lovely serum that adds just the right amount of glow. Love it!
Love it I have mature skin and it helps my foundation go on with a smooth finish.

avis.titre: The Vitamins you didn't know your skin needed!

It's definitely a repurchase for me over and over. This company cannot make a bad product! So happy I tried them.
This serum is unreal, I have eliminated so many other serum's & only use this one, my pores are almost invisible & my skin is glowing, highly recommend

I love the feeling of the dew drops. My skin feels silky and hydrated. This is a must try.

I also find that in the rare occasion that I wear makeup, it's a perfect primer to my foundation!
Have been using it for a few weeks now and my skin feels and looks brighter.

Such a nice moisturizer/primer. I use it with my foundation drops and it works like a tinted moisturizer. Love how it makes my skin look flawless. I get facials regularly and have good skin barrier. This makes it all come together making my skin feel and look it's best.
Love the texture of this serum… so soft and light! My skin just drinks it up and now has a beautiful glow.

This leaves my skin primed for makeup but I often wear alone. It's that great!!

These are so hydrating and look great under makeup. One of my favorite bloomeffects products!

ive ordered before and it doesnt break my skin out and is good for layering under other products

I LOVE this product and I'll scream that forever!!!!

avis.titre: This is the most awesome product

avis.titre: Tulip Dew Drops + the Cream Have Transformed my Skin
avis.texte: I'm 57 and have used SO many skin care products over the years and never buy the same thing again because I don't notice any real difference. The Tulip Dew Cream and the Dew Drop were given to me as gifts. I've now bought two more of each because the products have changed my skin, creating a smoother texture a more even tone. And just as important is how when I use my foundation, it looks so natural, doesn't sit on my skin, and looks like I'm wearing foundation. I was running low on the products, and when I received the email with the 30% of $x dollars, I bought two of each. I was literally feeling like, "Oh no, I can't run out"! And I received the package in just three days. I wasn't expecting such a quick turnaround on the shipping. I will cut and paste this exact review on both products because I use them together. I was initially skeptical because I noticed that the moisturizer and serum textures differed greatly from other products. I never take the time to write reviews, especially about skin care products, but I cannot recommend these two items enough!
I use the Tulip Dew Drops with my foundation. Mixed together it leaves my skin smooth and a radiant glow!
I do love this product l. I just started 1 week ago. It feels hydrating. Can't wait to see results.
